name: Love Of Money
overview: Scripture warns against the love of money, revealing it as a source of dissatisfaction and vanity, as those who love silver or abundance will never be content (Ecclesiastes 5:10). True wealth comes not from vanity or quick gain but through diligent labor (Proverbs 13:11). Jesus teaches that one cannot serve both God and mammon, emphasizing the necessity of undivided devotion (Matthew 6:24). Believers are encouraged to live without covetousness and to find contentment in God's faithful presence (Hebrews 13:5).
